dex.entry: A great water-plant entity that spans a pool entirely, raising arching vine-bridges of woven kelp. Rumoured to be a single kin or many acting as one. The spectacular pool finale — starts as something you could hold in one hand and becomes something you walk under.

art.silhouette: Long arching serpentine plant form, dark teal body, many tributary fronds like trailing ribbons, lotus blossom crown of bioluminescent petals; fluid and enormous.
